title: Deployment inventory
description: Binds a running environment to a traceable image digest, a configuration version, and secret REFERENCES only. Secret values are never recorded here (SAL-008).

provisioning.description: Synthetic means no live provider resources exist yet (ARC-005 pending).

digest.description: Immutable content digest; a floating tag is never sufficient.

tag.description: Optional human-readable tag for traceability. The digest is authoritative.

config_version.description: Identifier of the applied non-secret configuration set.

secret_references.description: References to secrets resolved at deploy time from a manager. No values.

name.description: Environment variable the secret is injected as, e.g. SALON_SESSION_SECRET.

source.description: Secret manager the value is resolved from at deploy time.

path.description: Locator within the source. Must not be a literal secret value.
